ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels; white pixels cover approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with black pixels concentrated on the perimeter and central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation along the trailing edges and distal tips; a central vertical black streak extending from the peduncle junction; multiple discrete brown/tan circular spots on the medial right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex and significant depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with multiple distinct, sharp peaks and irregular valleys along the entirety of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the distal tips and converging at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured clusters of high-contrast circular formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; several small, isolated circular tan marks on the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal extremities; a distinct circular void or 'hole' feature on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the center.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific dark, roughly circular mark on the medial region of the right lobe surface, distinct from edge serration.
